ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface; bright values dominate the distal regions, while dark values occupy the medial peduncle area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions on the distal 60% of both lobes; solid black pigmentation concentrated at the central notch and extending along the leading edge; dark punctate mottling scattered throughout the white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees with a vertical depth of ~40 pixels at current resolution.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing boundary; peak-to-valley amplitude varies between 3-12 pixels; serrations appear more jagged and irregular on the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; subtle concave sweep originating from the median notch transitioning into a broad convex curve toward the pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-intensity circular pixel clusters (mottling) distributed across the white fields; one prominent cluster on the mid-left lobe and several smaller clusters on the lower-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: At least four distinct, dark, unaligned linear marks (rake marks) visible on the white field of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct parallel linear rake marks on the right lobe surface; ragged edge topography suggests minor historical tissue loss along the distal trailing margins.
